title: 面对质疑，LDV合伙人：每个公司都有它的评判者，时间会证明
speaker: Winston Foo

segments.en: What do you make of some that are maybe not as hopeful as you, right? The likes of Jim Chanos, for example, saying that this is a hopes and dreams IPO.
segments.zh: 你怎么看那些不那么乐观的人？比如Jim Chanos说这是希望和梦想的IPO。

segments.en: You look at the fundamentals and this is a company that is not making money yet. Or at least the revenue numbers are not really justifying this massive valuation.
segments.zh: 看基本面，这家公司还没盈利，营收数字难以支撑如此高的估值。

segments.en: What's the argument against that now?
I think the great thing about investing and company building is that at the end of the day there's a crack refer for everyone.
segments.zh: 我认为参与和公司建设的美妙之处在于，最终每个人都有自己的评判标准。

segments.en: And so we shall see with time.
